scope: Every manifested new image with numeric ID >70, including empty labels. No canonical label changes made by this reviewer.
review_limitations: All63 originals and all1892 row overlays received full-context screen and text geometry checks. Only44 rows received separate native-detail crop adjudication; this is not a certification of every corner or every pixel boundary. Soft flags are review prompts, not physical laws. Color is contextual, not a universal classifier.

flag_definitions.large_lower_gap: stored ymax - max(y of available corners) > max(6 native pixels, 0.25 * box height)
flag_definitions.neighbor_point_inside: another row available endpoint lies more than2px inside this AABB; often valid for tilted fronts
flag_definitions.hard_geometry_checks: finite values, positive dimensions, box in image, hidden point zero-triplets, visible endpoint within own box±1px
